items.title: Randy Brecker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 12, 2022
items.q: They were — that facet of the government was actually very proactive then. They had sent Duke Ellington on a similar tour, and we actually followed in his path

ctx.x: How did he feel about you leaving school to go gigging?

Well it was that same thing — I left school with the intent of coming back actually. You know I went to Indiana University, and part of it was just happenstance. I went to Indiana University from 1963 to 1966. And in 1965 our big band and our sextet won the Notre Dame Jazz Festival. That was what we all would shoot for every year. The judges — well I just remember one judge was Clark Terry you know. And he gave me a trumpet award and part of our prizes if we took it, and we did take this, we were awarded a…
It’s interesting that you’ve spent some significant time in Europe and in fact very recently is that correct?
